push_aware_ev.rule: EV = p_model/p_be - 1 applies DIRECTLY only to binary moneylines. For spreads and totals with push probability: EV = p_win*(dec-1) - p_loss (pushes refund, contributing 0), and the edge comparison uses the CONDITIONAL probability p_win/(p_win+p_loss) vs break-even.
push_aware_ev.identity_preserved: EV > 0 iff p_win*dec > p_win + p_loss iff p_win/(p_win+p_loss) > 1/dec = p_be — the sign consistency of the binary case carries over exactly; only the numerator/denominator change.
push_aware_ev.repo_support: V13 cards already emit the full settlement split for totals (v13.p_over / p_push / p_under — the correction-5 tooling fix) so the push-aware inputs exist natively; ML rows are binary (extra-innings rules preclude pushes); run-line rows settle at ±1.5 and cannot push. The NFL grading frame's tie rule is the same principle applied to grading: a push/tie is excluded from the binary record, never counted as a loss.
push_aware_ev.status: the implemented selector already handles the distinction (owner-stated); this record preserves the precision so no future implementation regresses to the binary formula on pushable markets.
